title: Listening - Volume 15
description: Master Listening through vocabulary, conversation, grammar, and audio.
subtitle: Listening (A2)

steps.title: Bem-vindo: Listening - Volume 15
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Listening". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I listen to an audiobook on my commute.
I watch movies with subtitles to improve my English.
I listen to a podcast during my commute.

steps.title: Desafio de Tradução
steps.question: Qual é a tradução correta para "audiobook"?

steps.title: Desafio de Compreensão Auditiva
steps.question: Ouça a frase com atenção e selecione a palavra correta pronunciada.
steps.audioText: I watch movies with subtitles to improve my English.

steps.title: Prática de Pronúncia
steps.text: Fale a seguinte frase em voz alta no microfone:
steps.targetPhrase: I listen to a podcast during my commute.

steps.title: Desafio de Escrita
steps.question: I listen to an audiobook on my commute.
steps.targetPhrase: I listen to an audiobook on my commute.
steps.correctTranslation: Eu escuto um audiolivro no meu deslocamento.
steps.explanation: "I listen to an audiobook on my commute." → "Eu escuto um audiolivro no meu deslocamento."

steps.title: Organize a Frase
steps.question: Ordene as palavras para formar a frase: "I watch movies with subtitles to improve my English."
steps.sentence: I watch movies with subtitles to improve my English.

steps.title: Gramática: Comparatives and Superlatives
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Comparatives and Superlatives"?
options: Would you go if he invited you?
I have been studying for three hours.
He speaks as well as you do.

steps.title: Idiom: Cost an arm and a leg
steps.text: It means: "To be very expensive.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: That car cost an arm and a leg.
